name: OfficeDataSourceObject
description: Represents the mail merge data source in a mail merge operation.
remarks: To work with the OfficeDataSourceObject object, dimension a variable as an OfficeDataSourceObject object. You can then work with the different properties and methods associated with the object. Use the SetSortOrder method to specify how to sort the records in a data source.
example:
Sub SetDataSortOrder()
 Dim appOffice As OfficeDataSourceObject

 Set appOffice = Application.OfficeDataSourceObject
 appOffice.Open bstrConnect:="DRIVER=SQL Server;SERVER=ServerName;" & _
 "UID=user;PWD=;DATABASE=Northwind", bstrTable:="Employees"

 appOffice.SetSortOrder SortField1:="ZipCode", _
 SortAscending1:=False, SortField2:="LastName", _
 SortField3:="FirstName"
End Sub

properties.name: ConnectString
properties.description: Gets or sets a String that represents the connection to the specified mail merge data source. Read/write.

properties.name: Table
properties.description: Gets a String that represents the name of the table within the data source file that contains the mail merge records. The returned value may be blank if the table name is unknown or not applicable to the current data source. Read-only.

properties.name: DataSource
properties.description: Gets or sets a String that represents the name of the attached data source. Read/write.

properties.name: Columns
properties.description: Gets an ODSOColumns object that represents the fields in a data source. Read-only.

properties.name: RowCount
properties.description: Gets a Long that represents the number of records in the specified data source. Read-only.

properties.name: Filters
properties.description: Gets the filter status for an OfficeDataSourceObject object. Read-only.

methods.name: Move
methods.signature: Move(MsoMoveRow As MsoMoveRow, [RowNbr As Long]) As Long
methods.description: Moves a record in a return set from an OfficeDataSourceObject object from one position to another.

parameters.name: MsoMoveRow
parameters.description: A constant specifying which row to move.

parameters.name: RowNbr
parameters.description: The number of the destination row.

methods.name: Open
methods.signature: Open([bstrSrc As String], [bstrConnect As String], [bstrTable As String], [fOpenExclusive As Long], [fNeverPrompt As Long])
methods.description: Opens a table in an OfficeDataSourceObject object.

parameters.name: bstrSrc
parameters.description: Contains the name of the data source.

parameters.name: bstrConnect
parameters.description: Contains the connection string to the data source.

parameters.name: fOpenExclusive
parameters.description: Indicates whether the table should be opened for exclusive access.

parameters.name: fNeverPrompt
parameters.description: Indicates whether to notify the user if the table cannot be opened.

methods.name: SetSortOrder
methods.signature: SetSortOrder(SortField1 As String, [SortAscending1 As Boolean], [SortField2 As String], [SortAscending2 As Boolean], [SortField3 As String], [SortAscending3 As Boolean])
methods.description: Sets the sort order for mail merge data.

parameters.name: SortField1
parameters.description: The first field on which to sort the mail merge data.

parameters.name: SortAscending1
parameters.description: True (default) to perform an ascending sort on SortField1; False to perform a descending sort.

parameters.name: SortField2
parameters.description: The second field on which to sort the mail merge data. Default is an empty string.

parameters.name: SortAscending2
parameters.description: True (default) to perform an ascending sort on SortField2; False to perform a descending sort.

parameters.name: SortField3
parameters.description: The third field on which to sort the mail merge data. Default is an empty string.

parameters.name: SortAscending3
parameters.description: True (default) to perform an ascending sort on SortField3; False to perform a descending sort.

methods.name: ApplyFilter
methods.description: Applies a filter to a mail merge data source to filter specified records meeting specified criteria.
